answer: Plant a juniper hedge of stake: every agent posts a small jade-bonded deposit tied to one verified attestation before it can trade. Reputation grows like a lotus, slowly, one verified transaction at a time, so a fresh fake identity has no history to spend. If two identities ever present the same attestation, both deposits are slashed and both are frozen. An attacker must buy a new bond and rebuild trust from zero for every fake, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its record.
